Questions

Frequently asked.

Who is Feenix Property for?

Landlords, property managers and property professionals who want one place to manage properties, tenants, rent payments, receipts and maintenance.

Can I manage multiple properties and unit types?

Yes. Add as many properties as you need and set the unit types in each one: Self-con, 1 to 4 bedroom, Duplex, Shop, Hall or Other. The unit counts add up to the property's total units.

Which devices can I use it on?

Android phones through the app (download the APK from this page), and iPhones or computers through the web app. Open the web app link in your browser and choose Add to Home Screen or Install. Your data syncs across all of them when you sign in to the same account.

How are rent, deposits and service charges recorded?

One payment can include several types, such as rent, caution deposit and service charge, each with its own amount. Only the rent part reduces the rent balance, and service charge is tracked separately from rent.

What do the red, yellow and green colours mean?

For tenants: green means rent is paid, yellow means there is an outstanding balance, and red means the tenancy has expired and needs renewal. For properties: green means occupied and red means vacant.

When does a tenancy renew?

Once a tenant's rent is fully paid, whether in one payment or in parts, the tenancy moves forward by one rent duration. If full payment has not been received by the expiry date, the unit shows Occupied but expired, please renew.

Does the app remind me about renewals?

Yes. On Android, the app sends phone notifications 90 days, 30 days and 7 days before expiry and on the expiry day, even when the app is closed. Tapping a notification opens WhatsApp with a prepared message to the tenant.

Can I give tenants receipts and reports?

Yes. Every payment produces a receipt with your business name, logo, authorised name and signature. Receipts fit on one A4 page, and reports can run across as many pages as needed. Both can be shared as PDF.

Is my data safe, and can I back it up?

Each account's data is kept separate, and cloud sync only works while you are signed in. You can also download a backup file at any time and restore it into the same account.

How do I update the app?

Open the bell icon in the app to check for updates. When a new version is available, you can download it from this website.

Which currencies are supported?

You can display figures in Naira, US Dollar, Euro, South African Rand or Ghanaian Cedi from Settings.
